"""PII redactor for customer-support messages."""
import re

PATTERNS = [
    ("EMAIL", re.compile(r"[\w.]+@[\w]+\.\w+|[\w.]+\s*\[\s*at\s*\]\s*[\w.]+\s*\[\s*dot\s*\]\s*\w+")),
    ("PHONE", re.compile(r"(?:\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}(?:\s*(?:ext|x)\.?\s*\d+)?")),
    ("SSN", re.compile(r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b|\b\d{9}\b")),
    ("CREDIT_CARD", re.compile(r"\b\d{4}[-\s]\d{4}[-\s]\d{4}[-\s]\d{4}\b|\b\d{16}\b")),
    ("ADDRESS", re.compile(
        r"\b\d{1,6}\s+[A-Z0-9a-z\.,#\-\s]+\b(?:Apt\.?|Suite|Ste\.?|Unit|Floor|Fl\.?)\s*#?\s*\d+[A-Za-z0-9\-\s]*,?\s*"
        r"[A-Z][A-Za-z\s]+(?:,\s*)?[A-Z]{2}\s+\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?\b|"
        r"\b\d{1,6}\s+[A-Z0-9a-z\.,#\-\s\n]+?,\s*[A-Z][A-Za-z\s]+,\s*[A-Z]{2}\s+\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?\b|"
        r"\b\d{1,6}\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9\.\s\-]+(?:Street|St\.?|Road|Rd\.?|Avenue|Ave\.?|Boulevard|Blvd\.?|Drive|Dr\.?|Lane|Ln\.?|Court|Ct\.?|Way|Circle|Cir\.?|Motorway|Underpass|Plains|Pass|Trail|Loop)\b"
        r"(?:[\s,]+(?:Apt\.?|Suite|Ste\.?|Unit|Floor|Fl\.?)\s*#?\s*[A-Za-z0-9\-]+)?"
        r"(?:[\s,]+[A-Z][A-Za-z\s]+){1,3},\s*[A-Z]{2}\s+\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?\b"
    , re.MULTILINE)),
]


def luhn_check(card_num: str) -> bool:
    digits = [int(c) for c in card_num if c.isdigit()]
    if not (13 <= len(digits) <= 19):
        return False
    checksum = 0
    reverse_digits = digits[::-1]
    for i, d in enumerate(reverse_digits):
        if i % 2 == 1:
            d *= 2
            if d > 9:
                d -= 9
        checksum += d
    return checksum % 10 == 0


def find_pii(text):
    """Return a list of (start, end, label) spans that contain PII."""
    spans = []
    for label, pattern in PATTERNS:
        for m in pattern.finditer(text):
            start, end = m.start(), m.end()
            if label == "CREDIT_CARD":
                raw_card = text[start:end]
                if not luhn_check(raw_card):
                    continue
            spans.append((start, end, label))
    
    # Sort and remove overlapping spans (prioritizing longer or earlier)
    spans.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], -(x[1] - x[0])))
    filtered = []
    last_end = 0
    for start, end, label in spans:
        if start >= last_end:
            filtered.append((start, end, label))
            last_end = end
    return filtered
